title: Surface parity audit -- SEO landing pages (Parrish, before-fix)

meta.note: Ground truth = top of computeEligibleSet's score-ordered list (the real chipIdentity->rankInventory pipeline). A row exists for every one of the TOP 20 eligible places per category that the production landing page's rendered HTML does not carry. Landing pages are SSG/ISR with no client pagination, so an eligible place absent here is invisible to both readers and crawlers -- the SEO-facing form of the same capped/unordered-read defect.
